title: cinnamomum uninervium
intro: Cinnamomum uninervium, commonly known as Ceylon cinnamon or Indian cinnamon, is a plant species belonging to the family Lauraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving blood sugar control, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cinnamomum uninervium include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cinnamaldehyde, cinnamic acid, and eugenol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
